description: Raw realtime data from proxy_requests. Use short time ranges (last 1h–24h) for fast queries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies p WHERE p.active = true
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

SELECT SUM(s.total_requests) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.avg_response_time_ms * s.total_requests) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 0) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND s.avg_response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.ip_change_count), 0) AS value
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)

SELECT
  FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600 AS time_sec,
  SUM(s.total_requests)                               AS total_requests
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.window_start) / 3600) * 3600               AS time_sec,
  ROUND(SUM(s.success_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_requests), 0), 2) AS success_rate
FROM proxy_requests_5min_summary s
JOIN proxies p ON s.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE s.window_start >= $__timeFrom() AND s.window_start <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)'
            THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(ir.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND ir.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as periodic_success,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type = 'periodic' AND ir.success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as periodic_failure,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type != 'periodic' AND ir.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as continuous_success,
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.cycle_type != 'periodic' AND ir.success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as continuous_failure
FROM ip_rotations ir
JOIN rotation_cycles rc ON rc.id = ir.cycle_id
JOIN proxies p ON ir.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE ir.rotation_timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND ir.rotation_timestamp <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as time_sec,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips_count
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE r.timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND r.timestamp <= $__timeTo()
  AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT
  p.device_id as proxy_id,
  COALESCE(p.name, p.device_id) as device_name,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END as server_name,
  COUNT(*) as total_requests,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as success_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as failure_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'TIMEOUT' THEN 1 END) as timeout_count,
  GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) - 1, 0) as ip_change_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip ORDER BY r.outbound_ip SEPARATOR ', ') as ip_history
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE r.timestamp >= $__timeFrom() AND r.timestamp <= $__timeTo()
  AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}') ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END) IN ($server)
  AND p.device_id IN ($phone)
GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_requests DESC
